title: SimpleInventoryRestore
description: A Simple, drag and drop inventory restore plugin.
body:
# **SimpleInventoryRestore**
_User-friendly inventory backup and restore with GUI_

## **Features**
Automatically saves inventories when a player dies
Staff can manually restore inventories
View and preview backups using a GUI
Armor, offhand, and hotbar slots are all preserved
Up to 15 restore points per player
Fully async file I/O (non-thread-blocking)
Preserves NBT data, enchantments, lore, names, and more
Commands & Permissions
/invrestore <player> - Opens the restore GUI for a player
Permission: invrestore.restore
/invrestorereload - Reloads and re-applies the plugin's config.
Permission: invrestore.reload


## **Installation**
Download the plugin .jar
Drop it in your server's /plugins folder
Restart the server
Use /invrestore <player> to start restoring!
️Configuration
One line! "max-backups:"

## **Future Plans**
Customizable messages
Need help or want to report a bug? Contact rythefirst on Spigot or Use the Leave feedback button!
